description: While searching, code keeps the Guide/Reference topic sidebar on the left; the design's search state has no sidebar, so in code the search field and results are about 215px narrower
note: [rail-in-search] code always renders the topic rail

description: Results are in a different order: design ranks Split pane, Open files in a split, Preview beside, Inline ⇄ split diff, Move pane in direction, Add pane to group; code ranks Split pane, Move pane in direction, Inline ⇄ split diff, Add pane to group, Preview beside, Open files in a split
note: [result-order] code's ranking differs from the design's

description: "Add pane to group — unsplit a tab" (not available in this pane) is dimmed to half opacity in design; code shows it at full strength like the available rows
Match count sits outside the search field, to its right, instead of right-aligned inside the field
Clear (✕) button inside the search field is missing
The "no match in GUIDE topics · search "split" in Search everything /" hint under the results is missing
Footer shows the generic "click keys to rebind · live from the command registry" instead of the search hints "↑↓ move · ↵ run Split pane · esc clear, then close"
note: [footer-hints] footer copy is hard-coded in the app

description: When a command has several key groups, code puts a faint "·" between the caps (⌘D · ⌘⇧D, ⌘⌥O · ⌘⌥⇧O); design spaces them 3px apart
Bordered boxes are smaller in code because the design adds borders outside the authored size: key caps 18px vs 21px tall, search field 34px vs 36px, footer 34px vs 35px
Key-cap label ink is lighter in code: #6B6862 vs #5A564E
Area outside the dialog is white in the design artboard and the warm window background #F5F4F1 in the code harness. Not a product defect
